rows.text: Section 5 replaces section 15 of the Legislative Assembly Act: 'The King shall on the recommendation of the Legislative Assembly appoint one of the elected representatives of the nobles to be the Speaker who shall preside over all meetings and he shall hold office as provided in clause 61 of the Constitution.'
rows.uncertainty: Statute text: procedure only, never a date for any holder. MIC's English release of 19 July 2012 cites this rule as 'Clause 15 of the Legislative Assembly Act' and the Assembly's Tongan item of the same day cites 'kupu 16'; the numbering difference is recorded, not resolved.

rows.text: Section 6 replaces section 16: the King appoints a Deputy Speaker from the elected representatives of the nobles on the Assembly's recommendation, and 'If the Speaker is not presiding, or if there is no Speaker, the Deputy Speaker shall preside over the Assembly and perform the duties of the Speaker until the Speaker is able to resume the chair and perform his duties.'
rows.uncertainty: Procedure only. A Deputy Speaker presiding or acting as Speaker is a claim only, never a Speaker holder.

rows.text: Act No. 21 of 2010 prints the assent 'I assent, GEORGE TUPOU V, 24th November 2010' and the line 'Passed by the Legislative Assembly this 22th day of July 2010' (as printed).
rows.locator: PDF page 5 (assent block); PDF page 8 (passage line)
rows.uncertainty: Enactment metadata of the procedure only; no commencement provision is printed. Not a Speaker event, so no structured date is stored on this claim.

bounded_scope: Speaker observations for CLAUDE-C01-24 only (role to_speaker on the to_legislative_assembly observation).
